Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on Emma Johnson's Hawaii vacation plans (June 10–20, 2024)

- Swimwear (for Waikiki Beach and Kailua Beach)
- Sunscreen (for beach days, snorkeling, kayaking, and outdoor activities)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head)
- Casual outfits (for sightseeing, shopping, and dining)
- Camera (to capture the trip)
- Travel documents
- Snorkeling gear (for Hanauma Bay)
- Comfortable walking shoes (for Pearl Harbor, the North Shore, and Ala Moana Center)
- Light, breathable clothing
- A change of clothes and any personal items needed for the luau and hotel spa
